## 3. Detailed Case Studies & B2B Product Catalog (11 Systems)

### [01] OmniCheck (`omnicheck.kz`) — Flagship AI & EdTech SaaS
- **Category**: B2B / B2C Multi-Tenant EdTech SaaS
- **Problem**: Teachers spend 10–15 hours weekly grading handwritten STEM homework (math, physics, chemistry), while students lack immediate step-by-step Socratic guidance at home. Sending raw notebook photos to public LLMs also creates student PII/GDPR compliance risks and fails to detect classmate photo-copying.
- **Architecture**:
  - Next.js Edge Middleware subdomain multi-tenancy (`*.omnicheck.kz`) with 6-tier Role-Based Access Control (SuperAdmin, SchoolAdmin, Teacher, Student, Parent, Solo).
  - **Client-Side GDPR Privacy Shield**: HTML5 Canvas automatically masks student names on notebook headers in the browser before uploading to cloud storage or AI APIs.
  - **Perceptual Anti-Plagiarism Engine**: Sharp image normalization + 64-bit Perceptual dHash (`hammingDistance <= 8`) detects duplicate or re-cropped homework submissions across classmates in milliseconds.
  - **High-Concurrency Queue**: Redis + BullMQ worker queues prevent deadline traffic spikes from dropping grading jobs.
- **Stack**: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, Gemini 2.5 Flash Vision, GPT-4o, Sharp, Tailwind CSS.

### [02] LuminaMath (`luminamath.orizont.md`) — High-Load National Olympiad Platform
- **Category**: High-Concurrency Public EdTech Platform
- **Problem**: National mathematics competition required reliable online registration for Grades 2–8 across Moldova, deterministic 6-digit student ID assignment, and automated OMR (Optical Mark Recognition) PDF answer sheet generation without crashing when 700+ parents and students check results simultaneously.
- **Architecture**: Stateless containerized deployment on Google Cloud Run (`europe-west1`) with Prisma + PostgreSQL connection pooling and dynamic PDF/OMR sheet rendering (`pdf-lib`).
- **Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Google Cloud Run, Docker, pdf-lib.

### [03] SSP — Transactional Subject Selection Platform
- **Category**: Enterprise School SIS Module
- **Problem**: When hundreds of high-school students simultaneously select elective courses with strict classroom seat caps, naive database queries suffer from race conditions and overbooking.
- **Architecture**: Interactive matrix selection UI backed by strict PostgreSQL serializable transactions (`prisma.$transaction`), real-time seat quota locks, countdown timers, and one-click CSV/Excel schedule exports.
- **Stack**: Next.js 16, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, NextAuth, Tailwind CSS.

### [04] GM-App — Multi-Campus Executive Enrollment & Quota MIS
- **Category**: Executive Management Information System (MIS)
- **Problem**: Executive leadership across 7 campuses previously tracked enrollment targets, entrance exam pipelines, and tuition contract renewals across fragmented spreadsheets used by 50+ admissions managers.
- **Architecture**: Real-time executive MIS dashboard with campus-level quota tracking, automated daily delta snapshots, entrance exam funnel analytics, and role-scoped reporting.
- **Stack**: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Recharts, Tailwind CSS.

### [05] EduStaff IAM — Enterprise HR, Trilingual Digital CV & Google Workspace Provisioning
- **Category**: Enterprise HR & Cloud Identity Automation
- **Problem**: Onboarding hundreds of teachers and staff across 7 campuses required manual Google Workspace account creation, organizational unit placement, and fragmented paper CVs across multiple languages.
- **Architecture**: Unified HR portal with a trilingual Digital CV builder, PDF dossier export, and direct Google Workspace Admin SDK Directory API integration that provisions accounts, groups, and 100 TB+ Drive permissions in one click.
- **Stack**: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Google Admin SDK, Prisma, PostgreSQL, PDFKit.

### [06] Enterprise Media OS & AI Studio
- **Category**: Multi-Campus Content Governance & AI Editorial Hub
- **Problem**: Managing content consistency, ethical compliance, and multi-language publishing across 29 digital channels and 7 campus editorial teams led to bottlenecks and uneven quality.
- **Architecture**: Centralized Media OS with a 6-dimension AI editorial auditor (grammar, tone, ethics, safety, SEO, translation across 4 languages), kanban approval workflows, and automated social publishing.
- **Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Telegram Bot API.

### [07] Multi-Campus Corporate Web CMS & 3D-Secure Admissions Portal
- **Category**: Enterprise Web Platform & Payment Gateway
- **Problem**: A 7-campus international school network needed a fast, SEO/AI-optimized public web portal spanning 30+ routes in 3 languages, paired with online contract/event payments via local banking rails.
- **Architecture**: Hybrid Next.js 16 frontend + PHP 8.4 Headless REST CMS, integrated with Moldindconbank 3D-Secure (`CommerceGateway` RSA-SHA256) payment processing and full Schema.org / `llms.txt` GEO optimization.
- **Stack**: Next.js 16, TypeScript, PHP 8.4 REST API, MySQL, Moldindconbank 3D-Secure, Tailwind CSS.

### [08] Multi-Campus IT Infrastructure & Google Workspace Cloud (7 Campuses)
- **Category**: Enterprise Network Engineering & Cloud DevOps
- **Problem**: Operating 7 physical school campuses across Chișinău and Bălți required resilient WAN/LAN connectivity, seamless Wi-Fi roaming for thousands of devices, strict segmentation between admin/lab/guest traffic, and centralized cloud governance.
- **Architecture**:
  - MikroTik RouterOS core routing with VLAN segmentation (Management, Staff, Labs, IoT/CCTV, Guest Portal).
  - CAPsMAN centralized wireless controller for zero-handoff roaming across campus buildings.
  - WireGuard site-to-site VPN mesh connecting all 7 campuses + Linux production servers.
  - 100 TB+ Google Workspace for Education Enterprise architecture and AI-assisted incident root-cause diagnostics (`helpdesk` & `mikrotik` automation scripts).

### [09] My-Family («Береке» PWA) — Family Habits, Digital Detox & Analytics
- **Category**: Consumer Mobile PWA
- **Architecture**: Installable Progressive Web App with parent/child role profiles, Digital Detox focus timers, daily habit scoring engine, Recharts family analytics, and Telegram Bot reminders.
- **Stack**: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Realtime), Recharts, PWA Service Workers.

### [10] 1C:Enterprise Retail, RIB & Accounting Engineering
- **Category**: Enterprise ERP & Distributed Retail Systems
- **Architecture**: Modern 1C engineering workflow using 1C:Enterprise Development Tools (1C:EDT), Git version control, PostgreSQL on Linux, distributed retail synchronization (`Розница 2.2` / `РИБ`), and custom fiscal/accounting (`Бухгалтерия 3.0`) extensions.

### [11] Multi-Service Engineering Command Center
- **Category**: Developer Experience & Microservice Operations Portal
- **Architecture**: Zero-dependency dark glassmorphism operational dashboard indexing all local and staging services (`:3000`–`:8090`), port health status, and architecture documentation in one unified view.
